field.name: caID
field.comment: The ID of the calendar to be displayed (0: it's the one held by the page attribute named by calendarAttributeKeyHandle)

field.name: calendarAttributeKeyHandle
field.comment: The handle of the page attribute holding the calendar to be displayed (used if caID is 0)

field.name: filterByTopicAttributeKeyID
field.comment: The ID of the topics attribute of the events used to filter them (0: they are not filtered)

field.name: filterByTopicID
field.comment: The ID of the topic the events must be assigned to (used if filterByTopicAttributeKeyID is not 0)

field.name: viewTypes
field.comment: A JSON array of the views the visitors can switch to: month, basicWeek, basicDay, listYear, listMonth, listWeek, listDay

field.name: viewTypesOrder
field.comment: A JSON array of the views in the order they are offered, every item being the name of a view, an underscore, and the text of its button

field.name: defaultView
field.comment: The view the calendar opens on, one of the views listed in viewTypes (empty: the calendar decides)

field.name: navLinks
field.comment: true: clicking a day or a week moves the calendar to it; false or NULL: the days and the weeks are not clickable

field.name: eventLimit
field.comment: true: a day displays a limited number of events, with a link to the other ones; false or NULL: it displays all of them

field.name: lightboxProperties
field.comment: A JSON array of what the lightbox of an event shows: title, date, description, linkToPage, or ak_<event attribute key ID> (used if the theme supports the lightbox)
